audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Sett/Sett/Sett/Skill/Sett/Skill/Skill; the packet chart gives Sett Levels 1-5 and 1st/2+ items, with Level 6 to Warwick. The whys were also written a row out of step with their labels (whys[2] discussed level 6 inside the Level 3 row).
audit.why: Warwick's only fight-flipping tool is Infinite Duress at 6 (110s at rank 1). Before it and after it, Sett out-brawls him at 490 range against a 365-range bite.
audit.corrected: Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Warwick / Sett / Sett, with each why rewritten to its own row.

audit.why: Level 6 (Infinite Duress), first item and Sterak's are the real spikes and were already the ones named; only the level-6 owner was wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields claimed 'his Q heal is halved on healthy targets' or 'reduced while you're healthy', and nothing mentioned that Infinite Duress is a channel.
audit.why: Jaws of the Beast (Q) heals for damage dealt with no health gate at all. The 50% and 25% thresholds belong to Eternal Hunger (P), and they are gated on WARWICK's own health — he heals nothing above 50% and triples below 25%. The other 50% threshold is Blood Hunt (W), which marks YOU when you drop below half. Infinite Duress carries the channel flag, so CC ends it.
audit.corrected: Thresholds reassigned to the right abilities and the right champion; the channel-interrupt is now stated for the case where he ults someone else.

edits.before: - Warwick Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — His all-in lock. Dodge it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Warwick Infinite Duress (R): 110s at rank 1, a 1.5s suppress — and a channel, so CC ends it early.

edits.before: Sett: Warwick is weak levels 1-3 and his Q heal is halved on healthy targets, so Sett's grit-shielded trades win outright.
edits.after: Sett: Level 1 Warwick has only Jaws of the Beast (Q) at 80 mana, and Eternal Hunger heals him nothing above 50% health.

edits.before: Sett: With Facebreaker pull plus Haymaker true damage, Sett out-brawls Warwick in every sustained level 3-5 exchange.
edits.after: Sett: At 2 a Grit-fed Haymaker beats Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick's mana bar cannot pay for a second bite.

edits.before: Sett: Even at 6 Sett banks grit to survive the R suppress and wins the follow-up brawl against Warwick.
edits.after: Sett: Facebreaker at 490 out-reaches Jaws of the Beast at 365, so Sett opens every level-3 trade first.

edits.before: Sett: First-item Steraks/Bami snowballs Sett's sustained fighting; Haymaker true damage cuts through Warwick's lifesteal.
edits.after: Sett: Levels 4-5 Haymaker's true-damage centre cuts straight through Warwick's healing while Infinite Duress is still offline.

edits.before: You out-brawl him in a straight fight. Land Facebreaker to pull and stun, then unload Haymaker for true damage. His Q heal is halved above 50% HP, so keep him topped-off angry and out-trade him with your grit shield up.
edits.after: You out-brawl him in a straight fight. Facebreaker pulls and stuns, then Haymaker's centre is true damage. Eternal Hunger only heals him below 50% health and triples below 25% — so kill him through that window or bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: His R is a hard-locking suppress from a dash -- respect it. Save The Show Stopper to grab him out of his ult path or to counter-engage after he blows R. If you eat his R with grit banked, you still win the follow-up.
edits.after: Infinite Duress (R) is a 1.5s suppress on a 110s cooldown at rank 1, and it is a channel: when he ults a teammate, Facebreaker or The Show Stopper cancels it outright. On you, bank Grit and win the follow-up.

edits.before: You win the early brawl cleanly. Warwick is weak levels 1-3 and his Q heal is reduced while you're healthy. Pull him with Facebreaker, punch with Haymaker inside your grit shield, and you'll out-trade every exchange he takes.
edits.after: You win the early brawl cleanly. Warwick is mana-gated levels 1-3 and Eternal Hunger gives him nothing while he is above 50% health. Pull with Facebreaker, punch inside your Grit shield, and stay above 50% yourself so Blood Hunt never marks you.

edits.before: Keep him above 50% HP so his Q heal is halved
edits.after: Stay above 50% HP so Blood Hunt cannot mark you

edits.before: Q-heal off you while below 50% HP
edits.after: To sit low so Eternal Hunger triples

notes: The '50% health' threshold was attached to the wrong ability and the wrong champion in four fields — it is Eternal Hunger (Warwick's own health) and Blood Hunt (yours), not a gate on Jaws of the Beast. The channel-interrupt line is written for the case where he ults an ally, since a suppressed Sett cannot cast anything; whether a suppressed target can be freed by his own team's CC is not in the kit data and was not asserted.
